eṣā cāsau vārikakubvyomavatī ceti vā etaiḥ
paridṛśyamānairvāryādibhistadvatīmiti vā vigrahaḥ

vātanītasya patrasya parṇasya
mātāpitṛsthānīyaṃ vallivṛkṣaṃ asineva mṛtyunā naṣṭau

yeṣāṃ madhye ahaṃ
jīvaṃ tyajāmi maraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvānasmi te ke nāmeti saṃbandhaḥ

vividhaṃ ārabhyata ityārambhaṃ padārthajātaṃ saṃrambhaṃ
janmādyabhiniveśaṃ ca kiṃ nāma dṛṣṭavān

svakriyayā ṛtūnāmṛtutvaṃ minoti paricchinattīti ṛtutvamaḥ sūryastasya
āśāyā uttaradiśaśca yoge vasante taducitā puṣpaśrīriva

atha gādhiḥ ravau udayamāgate svātithau āpṛcchya gate sati vismayenoddhurayā
garīyasyā dhiyā idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ saṃcintayāmāseti pareṇa saṃbandhaḥ

mayā yatsaṃbhrame bhrāntidaśāyāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ taddvijenātithinā
satyabhūtamuktaṃ mama iti evaṃrūpamidaṃ kiṃ māyālakṣaṇaḥ
śambarasyāsurasya racanākramaḥ syāt
sā māyā mithyaiva tatra na saṃvādo draṣṭuṃ śakyaḥ

tatkathaṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyamiti cetpuruṣaprayatnasyālabhyaṃ nāstītyāha -
manorājyamiti
sa mārge prāvṛṣi ya ogho jalapravāhastajjavena tvaramāṇo'bhavat

vāta eva
turaṃgo vāhanaṃ yasya meghasya tadvat

īdṛśaḥ prāgdṛṣṭaprakāro nijācāro yasmiṃstadbhūtamaṇḍalaṃ ca
prathamamāgataḥ

saṃvidi buddhau sthitenaiva smaryamāṇenaiva sanniveśena saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa
sthitaṃ kaṃcidvāmakamapaśyat

citte cintito janmādivistāro yatra tathāvidhaṃ sa prāgdṛṣṭo yo
gṛhādiniveśastatpracuraṃ ātmanaḥ śvapacatvaṃ ca liṅgaiḥ
punardṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ

tacchvapacāspadaṃ kartṛ tasya manaḥ kāmapi
vairāgyapadavīmanayatprāpayāmāsa

āttatantrībhiḥ iti
pāṭhe latānāmāvṛtairāvaraṇairāttābhistantrībhiḥ pratānaiḥ
pariveṣṭitamityarthaḥ

analpaḥ smayo vismayaḥ saṃrambhaḥ praśnodyogaśca yasminkarmaṇīti
kriyāviśeṣaṇam

sakalabhūtabhukhādavyāhatamamṛṣārthakaṃ vākyamākarṇya svayaṃ
cābādhitapratyabhijñayā yathānubhūtamavalokya lajjayā gūḍhākṛtirgādhiḥ
śaśāṅkasyendormalavatkalaṅkamiva svahṛdaye adhirūḍhaṃ paramaṃ
vismayamājagāma prāpetyarthaḥ
